products.name: Workstation TR PRO AI Tower — Threadripper PRO 9000 WX

The flagship Workstation AI tower on AMD WRX90 with a Ryzen Threadripper PRO 9000 WX processor. Fine-tune and serve large models locally: four RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q cards give 384 GB of GPU memory, eight memory channels feed data pipelines, and 128 PCIe 5.0 lanes keep every GPU and NVMe drive at full bandwidth.

- 256 GB – 1 TB DDR5 ECC RDIMM
- PCIe 5.0 NVMe boot + data drives
- Onboard 10GbE, optional ConnectX-7
- Built, burned-in and supported in the UK
